summary.name: Conservative Singles
summary.description: LISA quality gate (P_true >= threshold, CV <= max_cv, >= min books) executed at the best recorded price. Realised, not simulated.
summary.best_for: Honest baseline for the gated pipeline

summary.name: Market Favourites (Baseline)
summary.description: Bet every de-vigged market favourite at its best recorded price — no quality gate. Realised; an honest benchmark for the gate above.
summary.best_for: Benchmark: does the gate add value vs. chasing favourites?

summary.name: Derived 2-Leg Parlays
summary.description: DERIVED (not a live market): consecutive quality-gated singles paired into 2-leg parlays at the product of their recorded best prices.
summary.best_for: Illustrative only — parlays must be priced at a real book

summary.name: Derived 70/30 Blend
summary.description: DERIVED (not a live market): 70% of the gated singles series plus 30% of the derived parlay series, both scaled from their real records.

summary.name: Always Home (Baseline)
summary.description: Bet the home team blind at its best recorded price — no gate, no model. The naive 'home advantage' baseline.
summary.best_for: Benchmark: does the gate add value vs. blind home betting?

data_provenance.source: football-data.co.uk (real matches, early + closing odds + official results)
data_provenance.note: Two snapshots per fixture: the executed line is the best early price across the archive's five books; CLV is measured against the recorded closing line (football-data.co.uk *C columns) — a real late-to-close price movement, not a real-time open/current line.
data_provenance.statement: No synthetic, simulated, or future-dated fixtures. All odds and scores are exactly as published by football-data.co.uk.
